basic_info.description: Spacious Home with Incredible Ocean Views! This one checks all the boxes! Features include: hardwood floors, dual pane windows updated kitchen with granite, remodeled bathrooms, updated electrical and plumbing plus a wonderful center patio to bring in an abundance of natural light! 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms on main level with a walk-in closet and a large 1 bed and 1 full bathroom (also with a walk in closet) on ground level with luxury plank flooring. Flat rear yard ideal for the green thumb enthusiast, big patio for barbecues and a garage that can include a host of hobbies. Lots of parking with Sunset Blvd and no neighbors across the street. Easy commute and 12 blocks to the beach!
